svg.text: HDIP 0.1 — M15-V05: Runtime, Formation & Execution View
One P3 Plane · Three distinct runtime responsibilities · Governing context · Consumption · Evidence-driven evolution
P1 — Governed Intent, Definition & Authority Context
The governing context remains applicable before, during and after runtime realization
(not a new canonical Plane or ABB)
Three peer ABBs, independently or jointly realized — NOT a Data → Information → Intelligence pipeline
Quality, lineage and Data failure evidence
Authority: Source and Data semantics retained
Shared runtime realization is permitted; semantic, Product, source and Decision authority remain distinct
X3 provenance · X4 telemetry · X7 currentness · X8 resilience · Other Overlays as applicable
Interprets runtime and consumption evidence; drives governed evolution and re-entry
INT-07 P5 → P1 · INT-15 P5 → P2
X1–X9 — Cross-Cutting Overlays (Orthogonal and Applicable by Context)
Compute · Storage · Messaging · Identity · Hosting · Orchestration · Security · Recovery
Enables realization; does not confer semantic, Product, policy, source or Decision authority.
HDIP Experience / Capability Context (not additional canonical Planes)
X4 observability + X9 economics + P5 value
One P3 Plane with three typed ABBs
Data need not precede Information or AI
PDEP / CEP / PFI / COVP are not Planes
M15-V05 is not the SSCF runtime flow
P5 interprets and triggers governed re-entry
HDIP jointly realizes governed Data, Information and Intelligence capabilities while preserving independent authorities.
M15-V05 · HDIP-CLA 0.1 / Frozen M17 · Logical responsibilities, not physical topology or universal sequencing
P2 resolves · P4 mediates the consumer experience
Discovery may lead to pure consumption or PDEP creation
Discovery / use ≠ automatic new Product qualification
svg.metadata: M15-V05 presentation view; M17 frozen; P4 consumer-facing discovery; source: V05 revised vector, targeted P4 update
